threat_event: Federated consulting account taken over through SMS code relay and used to bulk export dispute case files with PAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS codes from SYS-M1; case export permission for all analysts; SYS-P6 events not in the SIEM
existing_controls: SYS-G1 sign-in risk signals; application logs
treatment_plan: Block SMS for CDE access; remove bulk export; SIEM onboarding and detection

threat_event: Dispute analyst misuses the case export permission to sell card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Permission granted to all 2,400 analysts; no export alert
treatment_plan: Restrict export to supervisors with a ticket; export alerts

threat_event: Skimming script on the processor's hosted fields or hosted page
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory, integrity checks, and tamper-detection in place
treatment_plan: Keep controls; quarterly review of the script inventory

threat_event: Malware on the switch exfiltrates card data without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Segmented CDE; EDR; DNS and egress monitoring
treatment_plan: Annual purple-team exercise on the switch

threat_event: A data center failure halts authorization for more than 2 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Active-active design tested every six months
treatment_plan: Keep the semiannual test

threat_event: Settlement database corruption makes funding files late or wrong at a sponsor bank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly restores; manual reconciliation
treatment_plan: Automated file balancing before release to banks

threat_event: Bank service provider notice not given to Bank B or Bank D on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No designated contacts for Banks B and D; procedure does not cover incidents starting elsewhere
existing_controls: Fallback to bank CEO and CIO under 53.4(a)(2)
treatment_plan: Record designated contacts; extend the 4-hour determination procedure (POAM-005)
owner: Head of bank and network relationships

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over merchant portal accounts for refund fraud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA required only for refund, funding, and virtual terminal roles
treatment_plan: Extend required MFA to all merchant administrator roles

threat_event: Fraudster changes a merchant's funding bank account through support social engineering
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back verification on file; step-up in the portal
existing_controls: Re-authentication and 72-hour hold on funding changes
treatment_plan: Confirmation to the prior bank account; support script review

threat_event: PAN in dispute evidence held in consulting mailboxes is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 380,000 emails with PAN and cardholder names in SYS-M1
treatment_plan: Evidence upload portal; mailbox purge; PAN blocking on consulting mail

threat_event: Dispute case files kept 14 months enlarge the impact of any SYS-P6 breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No purge after dispute closure
treatment_plan: Mask on upload; purge 90 days after closure

threat_event: HSM key compromise or ceremony failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual control and split knowledge
treatment_plan: Annual ceremony audit

threat_event: Switch operations insider harvests PAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAN only through the vault; detokenization logged
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of detokenization by service identity

threat_event: Fraud model drift causes a spike in false declines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drift alerts weekly; no daily decline-rate alerts by segment
existing_controls: Weekly drift checks; fallback rules; model validation
treatment_plan: Daily decline-rate alerts by segment
owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud

threat_event: Fraud model declines some cardholder groups at unjustified higher rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proxy features (card type, BIN country, ZIP code)
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (15 U.S.C. 45(n)); Colorado SB26-189 (under counsel review)
treatment_plan: Bias testing plan (P10)
owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud

threat_event: Fraud model training data on the data platform contains PAN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training uses SYS-G4 extracts; PAN block now covers logs
treatment_plan: Pre-training PAN check in the pipeline

threat_event: DDoS attack degrades the e-commerce API
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge DDoS service; rate limits
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS test

threat_event: Known vulnerability in an open-source switch component is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patching within 30 days for critical
treatment_plan: Keep the 30-day standard; add runtime protection

threat_event: The 2026 ROC finds requirements not in place for consulting access and scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gaps open into the ROC window
treatment_plan: Close POAM-001 to POAM-003 and POAM-005 interim steps before 2026-11-02

threat_event: Card brand 3-day compromise report missed for an incident that starts in another division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Brand clock starts at reasonable suspicion anywhere in the group
treatment_plan: Group SOC escalates any suspected account data compromise to the liaison within 1 hour
owner: Head of bank and network relationships

threat_event: Ransomware in operations centers halts settlement staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Workstations in four operations centers
treatment_plan: Clean-room workstation pool for settlement

threat_event: Loss of a card network link
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two links per network per data center
treatment_plan: Annual link failover test

threat_event: Fraudulent merchants pass onboarding and run bust-out or laundering schemes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Underwriting model plus manual review
treatment_plan: Monthly fraud loss review
owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud

threat_event: Merchant underwriting model decisions cannot be explained to applicants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes not mapped to adverse decision letters
regulatory_driver: N51-R01; ECOA applicability under counsel review
treatment_plan: Reason code mapping; counsel opinion (P10)
owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud

threat_event: CDE administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing-resistant keys; PAM
treatment_plan: Keep controls

threat_event: Provider A outage takes the e-commerce API down in both regions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two regions in one provider
treatment_plan: Annual region failover test

threat_event: Containment that cuts off consulting users makes dispute responses miss network deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contingency plan assumes consulting staff are available
treatment_plan: Surge roster of processor staff; deadline triage list

threat_event: Theft of a workforce laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption; no PAN on laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted: Low

threat_event: Phishing captures a processor employee's sign-in
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Number matching MFA; awareness training
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for remote access by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Merchant API keys leaked by merchants enable card-testing attacks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Static API keys for older integrations
treatment_plan: Key rotation program for older integrations
